source_review.marked_range_lifecycle: each surface keeps its own marked range; replace_and_mark_text_in_range sets it to the spliced range, replace_text_in_range and unmark_text clear it, and every query setter clears it
source_review.cancel_path: an IME cancel arrives as replace_text_in_range with an empty string over the marked range, which removes only that range
source_review.commit_path: a commit arrives as replace_text_in_range with the committed text over the marked range, and the caret is placed at range.start + new_text.len()
source_review.focus_change: the handler routes by FocusHandle; there is no blur handler that clears or finalizes a marked range, so an interrupted composition keeps its text and its marked range on the surface that lost focus

native_observations.action: an ASCII probe typed "pre" into the Task Rail search
the Operator started a Japanese composition and entered にほ without converting
native_observations.expected: the preedit text appears in the field while the composition is unconfirmed
native_observations.observed: accessibility value "preにほ" while the composition was still open
native_observations.limit: the value shows the preedit text; whether the platform exposes its marked/underlined state through accessibility is NOT_MEASURED

native_observations.action: the Operator pressed Escape to cancel the composition
native_observations.expected: only the unconfirmed text is removed; the committed prefix stays
native_observations.note: a synthetic Escape sent by this session first did not cancel the composition; the operator's own key press did, so the cancel result is attributed to the operator's input

native_observations.action: the Operator typed にほんご, converted it and committed with Enter after the existing "pre"
native_observations.expected: one insertion at the caret; the prefix survives

native_observations.action: the Operator started a composition in the Task Rail search (かく) and then switched to the Flow surface
native_observations.expected: the interrupted composition must not corrupt either surface
native_observations.observed: the rail value became "pre日本語かく" and the Flow query stayed empty; no text leaked into the Flow field
native_observations.interpretation: the interrupted composition text and its marked range stay on the rail; the visible outcome is that the unconfirmed text survives the switch rather than being discarded. No cross-surface contamination was observed, and no defect was demonstrated.
native_observations.limit: what TSF does with the still-marked range after the focus move is NOT_MEASURED

palette_focus_restoration.reason: the Operator ran the palette open/type/close sequence, but by the time the state was read the OS focus was outside the application and no palette node was present, so neither the palette interaction nor the restored focus can be attributed
